unit.can_do_en: Can introduce yourself, say where you are from, and ask the same.

situation_en: Maria has just started a new job in Helsinki. In the break room she meets her colleague Aino for the first time. They greet each other, say their names, and ask each other where they are from. Maria is from Brazil. Aino is from Helsinki.

speakers.name: Aino
speakers.role_en: a colleague who has worked there for years

speakers.name: Maria
speakers.role_en: a newcomer in her first week at the job
